description: This file contains test scripts for the Project schema, including subtests for inventory, articles_cached_units, delete, and stale functionalities, utilizing Test2, DateTime, and a custom TestDB module.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the inventory counts of various project-related entities.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the caching of articles and their associated units, including memory cycle detection and cache invalidation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Test subroutine that deletes all projects and verifies that certain tables are emptied.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the stale status of projects based on date, including subtests for the is_stale method.
